name: Wysa Copilot
short_description: AI-powered clinician support tool that extends therapy between sessions. Provides clinician dashboard with patient progress insights, mood tracking, and crisis alerts.
long_description: Wysa Copilot is a clinician-facing dashboard that works alongside the Wysa AI chatbot app to extend mental health support between therapy sessions. Clinicians can monitor patient progress, view mood trends, receive crisis alerts, and gain insights into patient wellbeing between appointments. The tool helps clinicians identify patients who may need earlier intervention while providing patients with 24/7 AI-powered CBT and DBT support via the Wysa app. Wysa Copilot is designed for therapists, counselors, and behavioral health organizations seeking to enhance care continuity and patient engagement without increasing workload.
one_liner: Clinician dashboard for monitoring patient progress with Wysa AI chatbot between sessions.
best_for: Therapists wanting to extend care between sessions
Group practices seeking patient engagement tools with clinical oversight
EAP providers monitoring member mental health
Health systems implementing digital behavioral health with clinician integration
not_for: Solo practitioners without current Wysa implementation
Practices seeking standalone MBC without AI chatbot
Organizations without patients using Wysa consumer app

pricing.notes: Enterprise pricing bundled with Wysa for Employers or health system deployments. Contact Wysa for custom quote.

faqs.a: Wysa Copilot is a clinician-facing dashboard that works alongside the Wysa AI chatbot app, allowing therapists to monitor patient progress, view mood trends, and receive crisis alerts between sessions.

faqs.q: Do patients need to use Wysa for Copilot to work?
faqs.a: Yes, Wysa Copilot provides insights based on patient interactions with the Wysa AI chatbot app. Patients must be using Wysa for clinicians to access progress data.
Yes, Wysa Copilot is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and GDPR compliant. BAA agreements are available for healthcare organizations.
